emphasis_points: Highlight the table's spatial role in the room layout: coffee tables anchoring central sofa groupings; side and C-tables providing accessible arm-reach utility; console tables defining entryways and perimeter walls.
Describe tabletop surface craftsmanship and material interplay (e.g., tempered glass clarity, solid mango/sheesham grain, powder-coated iron bases).
Emphasize proportions, lower shelf utility (if present), and leg clearance tailored to daily lounging and entertaining.
avoid_list: Do not claim scratch-proof, heat-proof, or stain-proof properties without explicit manufacturer verification.
Do not assume nesting sets or companion tables are included unless verified in attributes.
Do not use vague adjectives ('chic', 'trendy', 'gorgeous') — detail material finish, chamfered edges, and structural balance.
tone_notes: Composed, functional, and convivial, celebrating tactile surfaces, balanced proportions, and effortless entertaining utility.
